properties.name: `CountingRead` — the second real implementation of `ifc:graph-read` — and `granularity` brought inside a budget written before the code changed. 552 store reads to 220 (N+2, N=218 artifacts), get_node 333 to 0. Wall clock did NOT move and that is the honest result: the budget bought the structural property that cost scales with artifacts rather than edges, and bought no speed. Guarded by a COUNT at three sizes plus an edges-do-not-cost-anything assertion, never by a timer.
